title: Eat Local New York
about: Eat Local New York began in 2016 as Eat Local CNY, an Instagram account Anthony Tringale started in Syracuse to encourage diners to choose locally owned restaurants. Tringale grew up around the business; his father worked as a chef, manager and restaurant owner. What began with reshared photos of restaurant dishes has grown into original videos, stories and events, and the account now covers the whole state.

Rather than rate restaurants, Tringale uses the platform to amplify them, telling the stories of the families and cooks behind independent places from Buffalo to Brooklyn and up to the North Country. Eat Local New York also produces a podcast with chefs, owners, food truck operators and other food and drink makers from around the state.
Each spring it runs Eat Local New York Restaurant Week. The second edition, in April 2026, brought together more than 150 independently owned restaurants across New York.
